name: MultiSelect
description: a native select that allows choosing several options at once
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in the Svelte canonical; ports to the other frameworks pending (2026-10-05)
aria: `aria-label={label}` -- accessible name; the `<select multiple>` is exposed as a listbox with multiple selection
keyboard: Arrow Up / Arrow Down: moves the active option (native); Shift+Arrow extends the selection (native)
Ctrl/Cmd+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Space: toggle one option (native, platform-dependent)
Native only: no keyboard handling is added
props: `className`: string (default: `""`) -- CSS class name appended to the base class
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<select>`
